verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a first-party Batch API for running asynchronous inference over large inputs in parallel at a 50% discount. That is a direct, product-native way to process many items in a single bulk operation. The evidence is a single short docs excerpt, so the depth of the feature is not shown. Missing for 10: details on batch job management (status, cancel, result retrieval), input format and size limits, bulk operations beyond inference requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Batch API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Batching allows you to run asynchronous inference on large inputs in parallel, reducing compute costs while running large workloads at a 50% discount.
